signoff.statement: Frozen before any model, optimizer or performance output existed. The generator was smoke-run twice into a scratch directory solely to debug the code (row counts and determinism were checked; the scenario was not tuned afterwards). REWORK RECORD: the first lock and fixture were discarded once because a data test found a generator defect (regime label flickered to low_risk on XKRX-closed XNYS anchors inside high_risk blocks); only the regime carry rule was changed, then this lock was frozen and the fixture regenerated. At that time no oracle, expected file, model or performance output existed. A second refreeze followed because a linter autofix altered the generator source after the first freeze; the logical hashes of all generated files were verified identical before and after (formatting-only change). A third rework changed only the fixed_regime_table.csv columns to the schema mandated by spec 7.5 (a requirement missed on the first pass); the other files' logical hashes were verified unchanged. No fixture files were written to the fixture directory before this lock. No independent reviewer has signed off.
